messages:
lucas (PM): quick sync — planning retirement for three legacy catalog entries next month. goal: zero customer surprises + a compatibility shim for common embed+chat contracts. what are the minimal ops + product guards?
deepa (Data): data reqs: need canonical prompt/response examples per model to validate parity. suggest 2k examples/model, weighted by token length and intent.
marco (SRE): ops guards: canaries, realtime metric diffs, throttled rollback window. propose triggers: error_rate delta >0.5% OR embed_cos_sim drop >0.06 -> rollback. want circuit-breaker to pause canary after 15m sustained error spike.
elaine (Legal): flag: customers on certain contracts require 30d notice. CS must clear customer list first. also need logs retained 6 months for audit.
maria (CS): can do outreach. customers might prefer a compatibility shim that maps old output fields — reduces their upgrade lift. can we expose per-tenant pin TTL? some ask for 60d runway.
lucas (PM): yes — plan is an output adapter: legacy_out and modern_out keys. per-tenant pin TTL in console + API.
marco (SRE): rollout config prototype:
```
retire_plan: models:["legacy-embed-1","legacy-chat-3","legacy-rank-2"],
canary:{cohorts:["internal","beta-customers"],duration:"2h",traffic:"1%"},
ramp:[5,20,50,100],
rollback_triggers:["error_rate_gt_0.5pct_15m","embed_cos_drop_gt_0.06_30m"],
shim:{enabled:true,translation_map:"s3://catalog/shims/v1/"}
```
deepa (Data): eval pipeline: pairwise A/B on canonical examples, compute length-normalized logprob delta, response-token-distribution shift, embedding cosine. badge if embed_cosine_mean >0.95 and logprob_delta within -0.08..+0.05.
elaine (Legal): opt-in UX must store consent record (user,timestamp,model_version) and exportable CSV.
maria (CS): add per-tenant TTL option in opt-in flow; also one-click Unpin in console for quick revert.
lucas (PM): automation: ops-bot will run checks and can auto-rollback but require manual approval before ramp beyond 50%. assign playbook to @marco.
ops-bot: scheduled canary start for legacy-embed-1 -> beta-customers at 2026-04-07T09:00:00Z. monitors: error_rate, p95_latency, embed_cosine_mean.
lucas (PM): action items recap: (1) Data: canonical examples + eval thresholds (deepa), (2) SRE: rollout/rollback automation + circuit-breaker (marco), (3) CS: contract-bound customers + opt-in flow (maria), (4) Legal: consent storage + notice language (elaine), (5) PM: UI copy + pin TTL UX. sync Thurs 11am.
